title: Copilot Studio: Python Code node as a step in workflows
summary: The roadmap description and documented capacity controls check out, including the API flagged by the pre-check. However, the page leaves AI code-generation billing open even though its cited billing guidance says building with natural language and using LLMs consume credits. The capacity path also stops before the settings themselves.

claims.where: Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout; controls[0]
claims.claim: Copilot Studio capacity is allocated per environment, with tenant-pool and pay-as-you-go overage choices.
claims.quote: Under Capacity overages, choose how an environment can continue using Copilot Credits after it exhausts its allocated capacity:

claims.claim: Managing credit allocations through the API requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator, or equivalent licensing and capacity permissions.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: The capacity control is reached through Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Under the Copilot Studio heading, select Manage Copilot Credits or Manage sessions. In the allocation panel, select an environment and specify the number of Copilot Credits to allocate in the Copilot Credits textbox.
claims.fix: The printed route is correct but ends at the panel before its controls. Keep the existing route and append ' > environment > Copilot Credits' for allocation. In the note, give the overage route in full: 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant or Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan'. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-copilot-studio-copilot-credits-capacity.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes environment credit allocations.
claims.quote:
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: The API body uses enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool to control drawing from tenant capacity.
A published environment-group rule for tenant-capacity draw prevents individual environment overrides in both the admin center and API with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: Without any overage source enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits.
claims.quote: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits.
